role: instrument channel definitions; no independent instrument recalibration
source_transformation: Dataset instructions prescribe mean of A_dist-Y and B_dist-Y, and force minus Y_force. COM records independently label force offsets in pN. Position units are documented by the instrument manual.
access: Manual channel list read via browser PDF text; direct local PDF downloads returned403, so no local original PDF/hash is claimed.
coordinate_limit: Publisher-defined average instrument trap coordinate, not corrected molecular extension. Apparatus/handle energy has not been subtracted. Its orientation relative to a force-conjugate external displacement has not been independently established; the signed integral is an instrument-coordinate diagnostic, not qualified physical conversion work.
fluid_temperature_limit: A_Temperature/B_Temperature are instrument sensors; retained Stokes/COM records do not by themselves establish local fluid T or uncertainty.
